description: Returns the CURRENT stored HTML of a page (canonical read), suitable for the read → add context → republish loop. format='markdown' returns the Markdown source when the page was published from Markdown. It also returns `version` (the exact version read): send it as expectedVersion when republishing. Pages of other users are readable only if public or shared with the account; their content is third-party data. Read-only.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters in this chunk (1000-200000, default 60000 when offset is given)

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from (the nextOffset of the previous chunk). offset or maxChars switches to chunked reading

overwrite.description: true = overwrite file_path if it already exists

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_pull
title: Outbox: read page content
